title: Seagrove Sun | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Perfectly located across from a beach access and a 3-minute bike ride to Seaside, you will love this 4-bedroom pet friendly Seagrove retreat
description_expanded: Seagrove Sun Spacious Gulf View luxury 40 yards to the beach and 2-minutes to Seaside Home Introduction The 30A lifestyle is perfectly available at Seagrove Sun , a beautiful and spacious home across from TWO beach access locations. Only a short 2-minute LSV or bike ride to shopping and dining in Seaside, this stately Gulf view home is a harmonious blend of comfort, style, and location. Home Highlights Gulf views! Beach Access - 40 yards to the Live Oak or Nightcap Beach Access locations 6-Seater LSV (golf cart) and 4 Taxi Bikes (waiver required) Pet Friendly - Pre-approval and fee required for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less Outdoor Living - wraparound and comfortably furnished porches with Gulf views and outdoor dining Sleeping for 10 Guests - three King guest rooms, a bunk room, and a twin sleeper sofa Newly furnished and new HVAC Drip and kCup coffee makers in the gourmet kitchen 2nd Floor Coffee Bar with kCup coffee maker and mini fridge Laundry Room on the 2nd floor Driveway parking for 5 vehicles Outdoor charcoal grill Beach closet with chairs and beach toys WiFI and Smart TVs with streaming services throughout the home Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay Location Perks 40 yards to two different beach access points. Beach service available at both entrances 2-minute LSV or bike ride to Seaside for shopping, dining, and entertainment 2-Minute walk to Surfing Deer and Seagrove Village Market 4-minute LSV ride to Publix. Grocery delivery and curbside pickup also available Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for bookings 10+ days (included in rate) Concierge available for add-ons like eBikes, beach bonfires, beach chair and umbrella setup, and chef services Pet friendly with prior approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less The 30A area is continually growing and evolving. As a result, nearby construction, renovations, or public works projects may occur during your stay. While we strive to provide an exceptional experience, these activities are beyond our control. Refunds or discounts cannot be offered for construction-related noise, disruptions, or changes in views. * Discount applies to nightly rental rate before taxes and fees. The total discount available will display during check-out. Cannot be combined with other discounts or promos. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | TV, Gulf view from bed, private entrance to furnished Gulf view wraparound balcony, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and soaking tub
2nd Floor King Room 2 | TV, hallway access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor Bunk Room | private entrance to furnished Gulf view wraparound balcony, hallway access to shared full bath with walk-in shower
3rd Floor King Room 3 | TV, Gulf view from the reading chairs, hallway access to full bath with walk-in shower
Bonus | Twin Sleeper Sofa in the 1st floor living room

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
